```{r}
# Parámetros
beta_0 <- 1.1
beta_1 <- -8.2
beta_2 <- 5.0
sigma <- 2.0
alpha <- 2.0
scale_param <- 1.0
sample_sizes <- c(50, 100, 200, 500, 1000, 2000)

# Funciones de simulación
simulate_simple <- function(n, seed = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)
  x1 <- rnorm(n, mean = 5, sd = 7)
  eps <- rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = sigma)
  y <- beta_0 + beta_1 * x1 + eps
  return(list(x1 = x1, y = y, eps = eps))
}

simulate_gamma <- function(n, seed = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)
  x1 <- rnorm(n, mean = 5, sd = 7)
  x2 <- rgamma(n, shape = alpha, scale = scale_param)
  eps <- rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = sigma)
  y <- beta_0 + beta_1 * x1 + beta_2 * x2 + eps
  return(data.frame(x1 = x1, x2 = x2, y = y, eps = eps))
}

simulate_with_z <- function(n, seed = NULL) {
  df <- simulate_gamma(n, seed)
  df$z <- df$x1^2
  return(df)
}

simulate_with_different_errors <- function(n, error_type = 'normal', seed = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)
  x1 <- rnorm(n, mean = 5, sd = 7)
  
  if (error_type == 'normal') {
    eps <- rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = sigma)
  } else if (error_type == 'uniform') {
    eps <- runif(n, min = -2*sigma, max = 2*sigma)
  } else if (error_type == 't') {
    eps <- rt(n, df = 3) * sigma
  } else {
    stop("error_type debe ser 'normal', 'uniform' o 't'")
  }
  
  y <- beta_0 + beta_1 * x1 + eps
  return(data.frame(x1 = x1, eps = eps, y = y))
}

simulate_with_more_distributions <- function(n, seed = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)
  data.frame(
    x1 = rnorm(n, mean = 5, sd = 7),
    x2 = rgamma(n, shape = alpha, scale = scale_param),
    x3 = rpois(n, lambda = 2),
    x4 = rbinom(n, size = 10, prob = 0.3)
  )
}

evaluate_with_cv <- function(X, y, k = 5) {
  # Crear un data frame para caret
  data_cv <- as.data.frame(X)
  data_cv$y <- y
  
  # Configurar control de validación cruzada
  ctrl <- trainControl(method = "cv", number = k)
  
  # Entrenar modelo con validación cruzada
  model <- train(y ~ ., data = data_cv, method = "lm", trControl = ctrl)
  
  # Extraer RMSE y convertir a MSE
  return(model$results$RMSE^2)
}

compute_confidence_intervals <- function(model) {
  # Extraer intervalos de confianza directamente de confint
  conf_int <- confint(model, level = 0.95)
  return(conf_int)
}

plot_diagnostic_plots <- function(model) {
  par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
  plot(model)
  par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
}

```

```{r}
# Simulación simple para robustos
set.seed(42)
sim_simple <- simulate_simple(1000, seed = 42)
df_simple <- data.frame(x1 = sim_simple$x1, y = sim_simple$y)

# Regresión robusta con MASS::rlm
model_rlm <- MASS::rlm(y ~ x1, data = df_simple)
summary(model_rlm)

# Regresión robusta con caret::train (M-estimator)
ctrl <- trainControl(method = "cv", number = 5)
model_caret <- train(y ~ x1, data = df_simple, method = "rlm", trControl = ctrl)
model_caret
```

```{r}
set.seed(42)

df1 <- data.frame(x1 = sim_data$x1, y = sim_data$y)

p1 <- ggplot(df1, aes(x = x1)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +

  labs(title = "Scatter x1 vs y", x = "x1", y = "y") +
  theme_minimal()

(p1 + p2) / p3
```

```{r}
mse_train <- list(x1 = numeric(), x2 = numeric(), x1_x2 = numeric(), int = numeric())
mse_test  <- list(x1 = numeric(), x2 = numeric(), x1_x2 = numeric(), int = numeric())
r2_train  <- list(x1 = numeric(), x2 = numeric(), x1_x2 = numeric(), int = numeric())
r2_test   <- list(x1 = numeric(), x2 = numeric(), x1_x2 = numeric(), int = numeric())
coefs     <- list(x1 = numeric(), x2 = numeric(), interaction = numeric())

for (n in sample_sizes) {
  set.seed(42)
  df <- simulate_gamma(n, seed = 42)
  df$x1_x2 <- df$x1 * df$x2
  train_idx <- sample(seq_len(nrow(df)), size = 0.8 * nrow(df))
  train <- df[train_idx, ]
  test  <- df[-train_idx, ]
  models <- list(
    x1    = lm(y ~ x1, data = train),
    x2    = lm(y ~ x2, data = train),
    x1_x2 = lm(y ~ x1 + x2, data = train),
    int   = lm(y ~ x1 + x2 + x1_x2, data = train)
  )
  for (key in names(models)) {
    m <- models[[key]]
    pred_tr <- predict(m, train)
    pred_te <- predict(m, test)
    mse_train[[key]] <- c(mse_train[[key]], mean((train$y - pred_tr)^2))
    mse_test[[key]]  <- c(mse_test[[key]],  mean((test$y - pred_te)^2))
    r2_train[[key]]  <- c(r2_train[[key]], summary(m)$r.squared)
    r2_test[[key]]   <- c(r2_test[[key]], 1 - sum((test$y - pred_te)^2) / sum((test$y - mean(test$y))^2))
    if (key == "int") {
      coefs$x1          <- c(coefs$x1, coef(m)[2])
      coefs$x2          <- c(coefs$x2, coef(m)[3])
      coefs$interaction <- c(coefs$interaction, coef(m)[4])
    }
  }
}

# Graficar MSE vs n
df_mse <- tibble(
  n = rep(sample_sizes, times = 8),
  value = c(unlist(mse_train), unlist(mse_test)),
  metric = rep(c("Train x1","Train x2","Train x1_x2","Train int","Test x1","Test x2","Test x1_x2","Test int"), each = length(sample_sizes))
)
ggplot(df_mse, aes(x = n, y = value, color = metric)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() +
  labs(title = "MSE vs n", y = "MSE") +
  theme_minimal()

# Graficar R² vs n
df_r2 <- tibble(
  n = rep(sample_sizes, times = 8),
  value = c(unlist(r2_train), unlist(r2_test)),
  metric = rep(c("Train x1","Train x2","Train x1_x2","Train int","Test x1","Test x2","Test x1_x2","Test int"), each = length(sample_sizes))
)
ggplot(df_r2, aes(x = n, y = value, color = metric)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() +
  labs(title = "R² vs n", y = expression(R^2)) +
  theme_minimal()

# Convergencia de coeficientes
df_coef <- tibble(
  n = rep(sample_sizes, times = 2),
  coef  = c(coefs$x1, coefs$x2),
  label = rep(c("β1","β2"), each = length(sample_sizes))
)
ggplot(df_coef, aes(x = n, y = coef, color = label)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = beta_1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = beta_2, linetype = "dashed", color = "blue") +
  labs(title = "Convergencia de coeficientes", y = "Valor estimado") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
mse_train_z <- list(x1 = numeric(), x1_z = numeric())
mse_test_z  <- list(x1 = numeric(), x1_z = numeric())

for (n in sample_sizes) {
  set.seed(42)
  dfz <- simulate_with_z(n, seed = 42)
  train_idx <- sample(seq_len(nrow(dfz)), size = 0.8 * nrow(dfz))
  train <- dfz[train_idx, ]; test <- dfz[-train_idx, ]
  m1 <- lm(y ~ x1, data = train)
  m2 <- lm(y ~ x1 + z, data = train)
  mse_train_z$x1   <- c(mse_train_z$x1,   mean((train$y - predict(m1, train))^2))
  mse_test_z$x1    <- c(mse_test_z$x1,    mean((test$y - predict(m1, test))^2))
  mse_train_z$x1_z <- c(mse_train_z$x1_z, mean((train$y - predict(m2, train))^2))
  mse_test_z$x1_z  <- c(mse_test_z$x1_z,  mean((test$y - predict(m2, test))^2))
}

df_z <- tibble(
  n = rep(sample_sizes, times = 4),
  value = c(mse_train_z$x1, mse_train_z$x1_z, mse_test_z$x1, mse_test_z$x1_z),
  metric = rep(c("Train x1","Train x1+z","Test x1","Test x1+z"), each = length(sample_sizes))
)
ggplot(df_z, aes(x = n, y = value, color = metric)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Impacto de z (x1^2)", y = "MSE") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
set.seed(42)
df_final <- simulate_with_z(500, seed = 42)

# Crear un ggpairs más estético
ggpairs(
  df_final[, c("x1", "x2", "z", "y")],
  upper = list(
    continuous = wrap("cor", size = 3.5, color = "darkblue", 
                     family = "serif", stars = TRUE)
  ),
  lower = list(
    continuous = wrap("points", alpha = 0.6, size = 0.8, 
                     color = "steelblue")
  ),
  diag = list(
    continuous = wrap("densityDiag", fill = "lightblue", 
                     color = "darkblue", alpha = 0.7)
  ),
  title = "Relaciones entre Variables",
  axisLabels = "show",
  columnLabels = c("x₁", "x₂", "z = x₁²", "y"),
  labeller = label_wrap_gen(10)
) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "serif"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "aliceblue"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "gray90"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")
  )
```

```{r}
if (!require("e1071")) install.packages("e1071")
if (!require("kableExtra")) install.packages("kableExtra")

# Distribuciones de error - Versión mejorada
error_types <- c("normal", "uniform", "t")
error_labels <- c("Normal (Gaussiana)", "Uniforme", "t-Student")
error_colors <- c("#3498db", "#2ecc71", "#e74c3c")

plots_err <- lapply(1:3, function(i) {
  et <- error_types[i]
  df_e <- simulate_with_different_errors(1000, et, seed = 42)
  
  # Calcular estadísticas para anotaciones
  mean_val <- round(mean(df_e$eps), 2)
  sd_val <- round(sd(df_e$eps), 2)
  
  # Crear histograma mejorado (sin skewness/kurtosis que requieren e1071)
  ggplot(df_e, aes(x = eps)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30, 
                  fill = error_colors[i], 
                  color = "white",
                  alpha = 0.8) +
    # Añadir curva de densidad
    geom_density(color = "darkred", linewidth = 1) +
    # Añadir línea vertical en la media
    geom_vline(xintercept = mean_val, 
              linetype = "dashed", 
              color = "black",
              linewidth = 0.7) +
    # Añadir anotaciones estadísticas básicas
    annotate("text", x = max(df_e$eps) * 0.7, y = Inf, 
             label = paste("μ =", mean_val, "\nσ =", sd_val),
             vjust = 1.2, hjust = 1, size = 3.5) +
    labs(title = paste("Distribución de Error", error_labels[i]),
         subtitle = paste("n = 1000, σ =", sigma),
         x = "Valor del Error", 
         y = "Frecuencia") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "darkgrey"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "grey90"),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
    )
})

# Combinar gráficos con títulos mejorados
wrap_plots(plots_err, ncol = 3) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Comparación de Distribuciones de Error",
    subtitle = "Impacto de diferentes distribuciones en la simulación",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, color = "darkgrey")
    )
  )

# Más predictores - Versión mejorada
set.seed(42)
df_more <- simulate_with_more_distributions(500, seed = 42)

# Crear un ggpairs más estético para predictores mixtos
ggpairs(
  df_more,
  upper = list(
    continuous = wrap("cor", size = 3, color = "#2c3e50", 
                     family = "sans", stars = TRUE)
  ),
  lower = list(
    continuous = wrap("points", alpha = 0.6, size = 0.8, 
                     color = "#3498db")
  ),
  diag = list(
    continuous = wrap("densityDiag", fill = "#9b59b6", 
                     color = "#8e44ad", alpha = 0.7)
  ),
  title = "Distribuciones Mixtas de Predictores",
  columnLabels = c("x₁ (Normal)", "x₂ (Gamma)", 
                  "x₃ (Poisson)", "x₄ (Binomial)")
) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#ecf0f1"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")
  )

# Validación cruzada robusta - Presentación mejorada (sin kableExtra)
set.seed(42)
df_cv <- simulate_gamma(500, seed = 42)
cv_mse <- evaluate_with_cv(df_cv[, c("x1","x2")], df_cv$y, k = 5)

# Crear un panel informativo más atractivo
cv_info <- data.frame(
  Métrica = c("MSE (Validación Cruzada)", "RMSE (Validación Cruzada)", 
             "R² (Estimado)", "n (Tamaño de muestra)", "k (Folds)"),
  Valor = c(round(cv_mse, 3), round(sqrt(cv_mse), 3), 
           round(1 - cv_mse/var(df_cv$y), 3), 500, 5)
)

# Mostrar tabla simple
knitr::kable(cv_info, 
            caption = "Resultados de Validación Cruzada",
            align = c("l", "c"))

# Intervalos de confianza - Presentación mejorada
mdl_cv <- lm(y ~ x1 + x2, data = df_cv)
ci <- compute_confidence_intervals(mdl_cv)

# Crear dataframe para visualización
ci_df <- data.frame(
  Parámetro = c("Intercepto", "β₁ (x₁)", "β₂ (x₂)"),
  Estimado = c(coef(mdl_cv)[1], coef(mdl_cv)[2], coef(mdl_cv)[3]),
  IC_Inferior = ci[,1],
  IC_Superior = ci[,2],
  Valor_Real = c(beta_0, beta_1, beta_2)
)

# Visualizar intervalos de confianza
ggplot(ci_df, aes(x = Parámetro, y = Estimado)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "#3498db") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = IC_Inferior, ymax = IC_Superior), 
               width = 0.2, color = "#3498db", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(y = Valor_Real), shape = 4, size = 4, color = "#e74c3c") +
  labs(title = "Intervalos de Confianza (95%) vs Valores Reales",
       subtitle = "Cruces rojas (×) indican los valores verdaderos",
       x = "", y = "Valor del Coeficiente") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "darkgrey"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11)
  )

# Diagnósticos con ggfortify - Versión mejorada
autoplot(mdl_cv, which = 1:4, nrow = 2,
        colour = "#3498db",         # Color de puntos
        smooth.colour = "#e74c3c",  # Color de línea suavizada
        alpha = 0.7,                # Transparencia
        size = 1.5,                 # Tamaño de puntos
        label.size = 0,             # Eliminar etiquetas de puntos
        label.n = 0) +              # No etiquetar puntos
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#ecf0f1"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#2c3e50")
  ) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Diagnósticos de Regresión",
    subtitle = "Análisis de residuos y supuestos del modelo",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5, color = "darkgrey")
    )
  )
```

```{r}
plots_err <- lapply(c("normal","uniform","t"), function(et) {
  df_e <- simulate_with_different_errors(1000, et, seed = 42)
  ggplot(df_e, aes(x = eps)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "salmon", color = "black") +
    labs(title = paste("Error", et), x = "Residuo", y = "Frecuencia") +
    theme_minimal()
})
wrap_plots(plots_err)

# Más predictores
set.seed(42)
df_more <- simulate_with_more_distributions(500, seed = 42)
ggpairs(df_more, lower = list(continuous = "points"), upper = list(continuous = "cor"))

# Validación cruzada robusta
set.seed(42)
df_cv <- simulate_gamma(500, seed = 42)
cv_mse <- evaluate_with_cv(df_cv[, c("x1","x2")], df_cv$y, k = 5)
cat("CV MSE (lm - caret):", round(cv_mse, 3), "\n")

# Intervalos de confianza
mdl_cv <- lm(y ~ x1 + x2, data = df_cv)
print(compute_confidence_intervals(mdl_cv))

# Diagnósticos con ggfortify
autoplot(mdl_cv, which = 1:4, nrow = 2)
```
